notes.title: Downfall surprise DLC release! Free wealth package and a base game discount?!
notes.content:
Hello, this is CFK.

Roguelike hack & slash game Downfall is coming to you with [b]a new DLC[/b] today (11/7)!

Pick up the new gold and blood stone pack to strengthen and synthesize weapons, equipment, and relics, further upgrading Faust's abilities.

We're offering a [b]new player support pack for free[/b], giving you[b] 1,000,000 gold and 1,000 blood stones at absolutely no cost[/b], so we hope to see a lot of player support!
(You can pick up the pack by navigating to the [Downfall Steam page] - [Store Page] - [CONTENT FOR THIS GAME] sections.)

In addition, to celebrate the DLC addition, the Downfall[b] main game will be on sale[/b] at a 10% discount!
Discount period: [b]November 7th, 2024 07 : 00 : 00 PST – November 21th, 2024 07 : 00 : 00 PST[/b] (15 : 00 : 00 GMT)
Buy Downfall today so you don't miss out on this great deal!

As always, we thank you for your constant support and will continue to strive to do our best for the future of CFK.

Thank you.
